Name: Johanan, Son of Kareah
Summary: Johanan, son of Kareah, was a captain who warned Gedaliah of Ishmael's plot, pursued Ishmael and recovered the captives after the murder, and then led the remnant to Egypt against Jeremiah's counsel, carrying Jeremiah and Baruch with them.
KeyStory: Johanan warned Gedaliah in secret, recovered the captives at Gibeon, then asked Jeremiah to pray — and when the answer was 'stay,' he led the people to Egypt anyway.
RelatedPeople: Gedaliah; Ishmael, Son of Nethaniah; Jeremiah; Azariah, Son of Hoshaiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: Asking God for guidance and then doing the opposite is worse than never asking.
